description: Source file implementing fake media stream classes for remoting testing, including FakeDemuxerStream and FakeMediaResource, with methods for creating fake frames and managing stream configurations.

classes.name: FakeDemuxerStream
classes.description: A mock implementation of DemuxerStream for testing, capable of generating fake media buffers.

classes.name: FakeMediaResource
classes.description: A mock media resource providing fake demuxer streams for testing remoting functionalities.

methods.name: FakeDemuxerStream::FakeRead
methods.description: Simulates reading a buffer from the stream, either returning a queued buffer or waiting for one.

methods.name: FakeDemuxerStream::CreateFakeFrame
methods.description: Creates a fake media frame buffer with specified size, key frame flag, and presentation timestamp.
